name: Cavalo do Sonho
body:
Cavalo do Sonho CR
12

This bat-winged horse is nearly hairless, with purple-gray hide that resembles cracked stone. It does sport a lush, flowing mane of black hair, and its tail is a long cascade of gray-black hair. Its eyes and nostrils grow with a livid internal fire, while its flapping wings creak ominously.

XP 19,200
CE Large outsider (evil)
Init +9; Senses darkvision 120 ft., scent; Perception +23; Aura evil

DEFENSE

AC 28, touch 14, flat-footed 23 (+5 Dex, +24 natural, –1 size)
hp 184 (16d10+96)
Fort +10, Ref +15, Will +14
Immunities electricity, fire

OFFENSE

Speed 60 ft., fly 90 ft. (average)
Melee bite +22 (1d4+7), hooves +22 (1d6+7 plus 2d6 electricity)
Space 10 ft.; Reach 10 ft.
Special Attacks breath weapon (15-ft. cone, DC 23, 9d10 fire plus catching on fire, usable every 1d4 rounds), storm burst (20-ft. burst, DC 23, 10d6 electricity), world walk

STATISTICS

Str 24, Dex 20, Con 20, Int 6, Wis 18, Cha 20
Base Atk +16; CMB +24; CMD 39
Feats Alertness, Combat Reflexes, Dodge, Hover, Improved Initiative, Run, Toughness, Wind Stance
Skills Fly +23, Knowledge (planes) +17, Perception +23, Sense Motive +15, Intimidate +16
Languages Abyssal, Common, Infernal (cannot speak)
SQ confer fire resistance, dream rider, illumination

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Breath Weapon (Su)

The cavalo do sonho can exhale a blast of fiery nightmare energy in a 15-foot cone. A creature that fails its saving through catches on fire, taking 1d6 fire damage each round at the beginning of its turn until the flames are extinguished.

Confer Fire Resistance (Su)

As a free action, the cavalo do sonho can confer fire resistance 30 to its rider.

Dream Rider (Su)

As a swift action, the cavalo do sonho can fade itself (and its rider, if it has one) into a figment of animate dream until the end of its turn, allowing it to move through solid objects and creatures as if it were incorporeal, though it treats solid objects and mindless creatures as difficult terrain. Attacks of opportunity against the cavalo do sonho or its rider while moving in dream-form are resolved as if they were incorporeal. The cavalo do sonho and its rider cannot attack while in this state.

Illumination (Su)

As a free action the cavalo do sonho can shed ruddy light like a burning torch or can stop shedding light.

Storm Burst (Su)

Once per day, the cavalo do sonho can release a burst of storm energy and fierce winds in a 20-foot-radius spread centered on itself, dealing 2d6 points of bludgeoning damage and 10d6 points of electricity damage (DC 23 Reflex half) to any creature within or entering the area until the beginning of the cavalo do sonho’s next turn. This area is treated as difficult terrain for all creatures other than the cavalo do sonho or creatures using freedom of movement or that is immune to the effects of strong wind conditions. The save DC is Constitution-based.

World Walk (Su)

Once per day, the cavalo do sonho can use ethereal jaunt, plane shift, or greater teleport. It can take its rider along with it but no other creatures; a rider’s familiar is treated as part of the rider for this purpose.

ECOLOGY

Environment any
Organization solitary
Treasure incidental

The bat-winged equine beast lives in dark caves in remote mountains and feasts on animals, humanoids, and plants with equal abandon.

Some sages aver there is only a single Horse of Thought, sometimes called pensamento, though that may simply be an advanced variant of the typical cavalo do sonho.

The pensamento is thought to be benevolent, called to a dreamer by the purity and generosity of their thoughts.

In a broken and dangerous world, however, negative thoughts and dreams seem far more common, and thus the evil-aligned cavalo are far better known.
